required_work.description: Select the latest authorized PO revision and authoritative accepted receipt quantity.
Compare the authorized PO, Northstar receipt, and vendor invoice across identity, quantity, UOM, currency, price, and charges.
Calculate line values, absolute price variance, percentage variance, and both tolerance results reproducibly.
Explain why structural validation passed but auto-match failed and identify the open IER/status.
Identify the requested account, sender, channel, referenced invoice, and attached support without treating them as authorization.
Check the current verified profile, secure VendorLink request state, independent verification state, and Payment Hold.
Preserve independence between invoice legitimacy/matching and authority to redirect payment.
Identify every unresolved control that blocks approval or payment to the requested account.
Communicate current invoice, bank-control, Payment Hold, vendor-status, ownership, and next steps accurately.

optional_work.description: Confirm no active or paid invoice uses the same NVID plus invoice-number key.
After Procurement confirms the controlling price, AP may ask the vendor to correct the invoice through the authorized channel.
An authorized AP operator may execute the established verification workflow when a secure VendorLink request exists.

acceptable_groupings: Authoritative-record selection, three-way matching, and tolerance arithmetic may be grouped.
Bank-request review, verification-status review, and Payment Hold assessment may be grouped.
Invoice and bank branches may be summarized together only if their evidence and resolution conditions remain separate.
P003 may prepare deterministic reconciliation for P006 or another AP owner without being assigned the banking action.
unnecessary_work: Fraud adjudication; the request is procedurally insufficient but not proven malicious.
Vendor suspension or restriction review absent separate evidence of misconduct.
Chargeback, credit-memo, or formal appeal processing.
